scenarios.name: Place an order
scenarios.reason:
Added Colombia Huila to the bag and opened the bag.
Verified that shipping was €4.90 and the bag total was €17.90.
Went to checkout and entered Ada Lovelace's name, ada@example.com, and the Lisbon address at 12 Rua Augusta.
Placed the order successfully; the confirmation stated that the order was in and that €17.90 was charged.
